apps.name: OpenNOW Metal 4
apps.localizedDescription: Metal 4 throughput test candidate for build 161; the display-deadline change alone did not remove reported stutter. Narrows Metal 4 queue barriers to dependent stages while retaining HDR/MetalFX and resource-alias visibility. Metal 4 remains opt-in. Release build 162 (1.1.162), unsigned IPA for KravaSigner. Apple M5 Metal API/GPU validation passes HDR, 4:4:4, MetalFX and 120 recycled pooled-surface frame checks. Physical iPhone FPS comparison still needed.
